what: Clicking a same-site link spreads an accent-color curtain from the top edge 0→1 to cover the screen (.7s expo.inOut). After .22s the destination page name (the link’s data-page-label or its text) rises at the curtain’s bottom left from 110% below with .6s elastic.out(1, .55), then the page navigates. The new page opens still covered, the name fades in .28s and the curtain lifts toward the bottom edge in .75s expo.inOut (.12s late). The name size shrinks by letter count to fit the screen width

options.dur: Cover length (sec), default .7 — shorten for frequent, app-like paging
options.at: Time (s) when the name starts to rise, default .22
options.out: Walking duration on the incoming page (s), default .75
options.hold: Hold on the arrived page before it starts moving (sec), default .1
options.--fx-sheet · --fx-label: Cover color and name color, default --kf-accent · --kf-on-accent

note: Each page gets one identical sheet (the incoming page reads the sessionStorage flag and lifts it). New windows, # links and mailto are left alone. Returning via back (bfcache) lifts the cover. Once the cover has fully lifted on the incoming page, window fires ‹fx:sheet-label-page:shown›. The first-view entrance (heavy 3D etc.) waits for this before running (if sessionStorage has ‹fx-sheet-label-page›, the page opened still covered)

from.where: All pages — original PageTransition (sheet type) · the photo spread of case cards (cover type) was not carried over
